english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a concrete quarrel or disagreement between people.
This is the all-purpose choice for an argument or failure to agree between people.
Use this as the everyday all-purpose noun for an active dispute or quarrel.

examples.english: They were having a disagreement over the queue order.
examples.traditional: 佢哋為咗排隊次序爭拗緊。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 wai6 zo2 paai4 deoi6 ci3 zeoi6 zang1 aau3 gan2

examples.english: We had a dispute over the homework for a long time.
examples.traditional: 我同佢為咗份功課爭拗咗好耐。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 wai6 zo2 fan6 gung1 fo3 zang1 aau3 zo2 hou2 noi6

examples.english: I don't want any more dissension with you over these little things.
examples.traditional: 我唔想再同你為呢啲小事爭拗喇。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zoi3 tung4 nei5 wai6 ni1 di1 siu2 si6 zang1 aau3 laa3
